lines.speaker: saldana
lines.text: Two transports. Forty-three survivors and the original relief records.

lines.speaker: nyx
lines.text: Government command frame is leading the interception.

lines.speaker: reyes
lines.text: They had more time to locate the convoy because we took the supplies first.

lines.speaker: civilian
lines.text: You were the officer who stopped the cleanup lance.

lines.speaker: civilian
lines.text: Some of us remember the damage your squad caused before you turned.

lines.speaker: saldana
lines.text: The quarry can hide everyone for tonight.

lines.speaker: vale
lines.text: Tonight is enough. Move the transports inside.

lines.speaker: saldana
lines.text: We lost the route. Pull back before the remaining families are trapped with us.

midBattle.speaker: saldana
midBattle.text: Transports are ahead. Government units are closing from the north.

midBattle.speaker: vale
midBattle.text: Convoy visual. Form around the transports.

midBattle.speaker: nyx
midBattle.text: Command frame identified. It will coordinate every target lock on the road.

midBattle.speaker: reyes
midBattle.text: One transport is below half armor. Shield it now!

midBattle.speaker: civilian
midBattle.text: They found us—please, do not let them finish what Hollowmere started.
